approval_required_for: Provisioning and accepting a new model-family verification case adapter when no registered adapter-generation capability exists; approval must cover its source/tool provenance, real-weight binding, TB/RTL references, and transformer-block-only scope.

Any change to accelerator architecture, pipeline structure, memory layout, DDR/AXI semantics, runtime ABI, model dimensions, tensor layout, decoder or attention semantics, numeric policy, precision, or trusted templates.
Any change to the human approval or forbidden-action boundary, or any attempt to promote a candidate artifact before its current-stage trust and evidence checks pass.

executable_actions.on_failure: Preserve the exact error, failed checker, source identity, and unresolved fields in the triage artifact. Keep input_preparation blocked; do not guess a case adapter, board target, tool path, or sample-project identity.
executable_actions.rationale: Read the exact prepared_inputs.errors entry and the declared source/tool indexes, bind the missing case-adapter diagnosis to current evidence, and preserve unresolved sample-project references. This is a read-only current-stage triage and does not promote or modify any downstream artifact.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep the candidate unpromoted and retain the missing-adapter error as the active current-stage blocker. Do not use candidate fields as validated downstream inputs, substitute a legacy adapter, or add random/identity model behavior, runtime-weight loading, simulation, or golden-output prerequisites.
produces: input/case_adapter.json (promoted only after candidate checks pass)
executable_actions.rationale: No registered tool can create the missing model-family case adapter. Implement or invoke planned_tool.case_adapter_provision to assemble a candidate from the supplied model, board, tool, and sample-project materials, including real weight references, TB/RTL references, compile-only VCS/simulator protocol declarations, and diagnosis-tool bindings. The candidate must be hash/provenance bound and must exclude model-tail operations from DUT weight coverage. This is a capability implementation gap, not a hardware correctness result.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep input_preparation incomplete, preserve every failed or not-run checker and the exact prepared-input error, and route only the checker-localized issue to another bounded current-stage repair. Do not promote to constraint_extraction, alter trusted templates or numeric policy, modify golden outputs, infer missing board facts, or rewind any hardware design stage.
executable_actions.rationale: Once the case adapter candidate has passed all checks and has been explicitly promoted with immutable provenance, rerun the complete current-stage input audits and aggregate gate. This honors the framework policy that input, provenance, evidence-binding, and orchestration failures retry the failed current stage rather than rewind hardware design.

observations: stage_passed is false and the latest stage command returned 1; this is an input_preparation failure, not evidence of a hardware design failure.

The exact current blocker is case_adapter status=missing: no verification case adapter was provided for this model family, including the required real-weight, TB/RTL, simulator, and diagnosis-tool references.
The design-team aggregate reports ready with five completed subtasks, but its audits and proposed actions do not establish a stage pass; the aggregate must be rerun after the blocker is resolved.

sacg_memory and sacg_memory_truth contain no active contamination barriers, retry requests, or backtrack requests. The attempt count is observability only and does not justify stopping or backtracking.
sample_project_index also reported a read failure. Treat this as an evidence/provenance risk requiring bounded revalidation; do not infer board, tool, module, or path facts from the compact summary.
No timing, synthesis, VCS, RTL, or board evidence is supplied, so no hardware-design backtrack category is justified. No compiled_pending_vcs backend condition is present.

The accelerator acceptance boundary remains Transformer blocks only; any case-adapter weight manifest or semantic reference must exclude embedding/tokenization, final norm, LM head/logits, sampling, and other model-tail work from DUT coverage and golden boundaries.
proposed_actions: Triage and hash-bind the exact prepared-input error without changing downstream artifacts.

Perform a bounded, approval-gated repair to provision a candidate case adapter with real source/tool references and transformer-block-only scope; no candidate is valid downstream input until all checks pass.
Promote the candidate only after static, provenance, tool-protocol, and evidence checks pass, then retry input_preparation in the current stage and rerun the aggregate readiness gate.
Do not backtrack to code_generation, parameter_binding, or any hardware stage; do not declare readiness or hardware pass on the current evidence.
risks: Promoting an unvalidated case adapter could contaminate downstream provenance, tool identity, model binding, or board integration artifacts.
Proceeding without the adapter would leave real-weight, target-model, TB/RTL, and diagnosis-tool bindings unresolved and would make later evidence non-actionable.
The unreadable sample-project reference can cause incorrect target or interface assumptions if not confirmed with current supplied materials and real-tool evidence.
Model shape, decoder semantics, numeric policy, data order, memory/runtime contract, implementation contract, and board facts remain unverified until the input audits pass.

A candidate adapter must not introduce runtime simulation, golden comparison, or weight-loading prerequisites into the compile-only acceptance standard; those references are metadata and verification inputs, not a new hardware acceptance gate.
output.summary: Do not proceed downstream or backtrack hardware stages. The current input_preparation attempt failed with return code 1 because the verification case adapter is missing, while the stage aggregate remains incomplete. Preserve all current artifacts, provision and validate a candidate case adapter through a bounded repair, promote it only after provenance and tool checks pass, then retry input_preparation.
